To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the QRNS is an effective technique to reduce the power dissipated by digital filters.
the QRNS polyphase filter bank is smaller than the TCS polyphase filter bank and that it consumes less power.

(1) the proposed architecture of a polyphase FIR filter in the QRNS is smaller and consumes lower power than a polyphase FIR in the TCS; (2) the proposed architecture is robust to process variations and to noise; (3) the QRNS polyphase FIR is able to process signals with higher dynamic range than the TCS counterpart; (4) the QRNS FIR is able to perform the computation of the polyphase filter bank at a higher frequency than the TCS FIR
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of digital filters for the QRNS.
the development of low-power, low-complexity digital signal processing systems.
the implementation of a digital filter in QRNS and its comparison to the traditional implementation in TCS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the QRNS is a promising approach to the design of digital filters, especially when low power consumption is a key issue.
the QRNS polyphase filter bank is more efficient than the TCS polyphase filter bank.
the use of QRNS for implementing the filter bank is advantageous in terms of both area and power dissipation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of a QRNS polyphase filter bank can reduce the power consumption by 40% compared with a TCS filter.
, for the same clock frequency, the polyphase filters in the QRNS dissipate less power, while maintaining the same performance of the filters in the TCS.
the use of QRNS for the implementation of polyphase filter banks is advantageous for low-power and high-speed applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the QRNS implementation of a polyphasic filter is a good candidate for low power applications.
QRNS is a promising solution for low power implementation of polyphase filter banks.
the QRNS is an attractive solution to reduce the power consumption of a digital filter.
